data.narrative:
Altara operates in AI & Software at an undisclosed stage. The available comp universe consists of one public peer (Palantir, ticker PLTR) and eight private peers including Figure AI, Scale AI, Reflection AI, and Applied Intuition. This represents a fragmented landscape with limited direct comparables.

A peer-median approach is not applicable here. While 12 same-sector peers exist in AI & Software, zero companies met narrow stage, adjacent-stage, or valuation-tier alignment criteria—falling short of the minimum three datapoints required for reliable triangulation. Using an all-sector median would introduce substantial distortion given the heterogeneity within AI & Software funding patterns and valuations.

The current analysis cannot support a specific valuation range without additional data on Altara's stage, revenue or usage metrics, capital raised, or management quality indicators. Key uncertainties blocking further quantification include: stage classification (seed through growth), commercial traction and financial performance, and Altara's specific positioning within the AI & Software stack. Until these inputs are available, or a sufficiently sized peer cluster with matching characteristics is identified, reliance on public market multiples alone (PLTR) would overstate precision. Recommend reassessment once Altara discloses stage and operational metrics.
